title: Angano...Angano...
synopsis: A documentary in which traditional Malagasy storytellers recount tales of gods, animals, tricksters, and origins. César and Marie-Clémence Paes filmed these performances with extraordinary attentiveness, allowing the storytellers' physicality, timing, and relationship with their audiences to carry the full weight of a tradition that has always been embodied and communal. The tales — by turns comic, erotic, violent, and cosmological — form a window into a Malagasy oral imagination that cinema rarely reaches. Its title echoes the traditional opening of a Malagasy tale: angano, angano — once upon a time. Won awards at Cinéma du Réel, the Festival dei Popoli, and the Leipzig Documentary Film Festival.
